A '''flash guard visor''',<ref name="SOTESB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> also known as a '''flashguard filter''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> protected a user from [[Stun/Legends|stun]] damage from visual sources, such as [[flash canister]]s or [[flash grenade]]s.<ref name="SOTESB" /> The visor was capable of activating within one-thirtieth of a [[Standard second|second]] after detecting a burst of light to protect the wearer.<ref name="EGWT" /> [[Ubese raider armor]] was equipped with a flash guard visor in the [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="SOTESB" />
